footnotes: Time-weighted, from daily sub-periods linked geometrically, with Modified Dietz across unpriced days within a month. Inflows count from the start of their day and outflows from its end.
A period under a year is cumulative and never annualized (PORT-GIPS-B07). A year is counted by anniversary.

Transaction costs and fund expenses inside NAV are deducted at every basis; net-of-fees deducts custody and other internal management costs; gross-of-fees adds back external management fees too. Other administrative costs reduce only the supplemental net-of-all-costs figure.
Margin interest is a financing cost, deducted at every basis.
Each row's disclosures -- large flows, estimated and stale prices, level-5 value -- are in --format json.
